question: Should OpenClaw continue sponsoring the experimental core Claw lifecycle stack, with this PR as the canonical read-only update-planning and consent-disclosure boundary?
rationale: The patch adds a broad new core CLI, persisted-plan schema, ownership model, and security-sensitive consent contract; code review cannot determine whether that long-term product boundary should live in core.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
options.body: Land the prerequisite diagnostics/ownership stage first, require exact-head redacted CLI proof, then continue reviewing this PR as the core planning boundary.

options.title: Pause the core direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer the experimental Claw lifecycle stack until maintainers confirm a narrower core or plugin-owned design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
recommendation.body: Land the prerequisite diagnostics/ownership stage first, require exact-head redacted CLI proof, then continue reviewing this PR as the core planning boundary.
